title: Stalks of the intersection ideal of a compatible affine cover
statement: Let Y be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], U an affine open, and (V_i) an arbitrary indexed family of affine opens contained in U and covering U. For each i let J_i be an ideal of Gamma(Y,V_i). Assume for each z in V_i intersect V_j that the extensions of J_i and J_j along their germ maps into O(Y,z) are equal. Put L = intersection_i res_{U,V_i}^{-1}(J_i), an ideal of Gamma(Y,U). Then for every i and z in V_i the extension of L along the germ map Gamma(Y,U) to O(Y,z) equals the extension of J_i along Gamma(Y,V_i) to O(Y,z).

source.place: Tag 01HR, lemma-affine-sheaves; Tag 01I6, lemma-compare-constructions; Tag 01LA, locality of quasi-coherence; Tag 0BVH, local determinant ideal construction

proof.text: Refine the given affine cover of U to basic opens D(f) contained in its charts. IsAffineOpen.exists_basicOpen_le supplies a suitable f at each point. The set of all such f generates the unit ideal by IsAffineOpen.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff; Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_finite gives a finite subset s still covering U. For each f in s choose a chart V_k containing D(f), and let K_f be the extension of J_k to Gamma(D(f)). The germ_res identity and Ideal.map_map show that K_f has the same stalk ideals as J_k. Thus the original compatibility induces compatibility of the K_f.

Prove the finite principal-open calculation directly in Lean (private finiteBasicIdeal_map_germ). Write L_s for the intersection of the contractions of K_f. The forward stalk inclusion follows from L_s being contained in the selected contraction, Ideal.map_comap_le, and germ_res. For the reverse inclusion, IsLocalization.map_under says K_f is the extension of its contraction to Gamma(U). Given a in this contraction, its germ lies in K_g at every point of D(g) intersect D(f), by compatibility. Apply IsAffineOpen.mem_ideal_iff on the basic open of Gamma(D(g)) defined by the restriction of f. The localization membership criterion IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff gives an exponent n_g for which f^n_g a restricts into K_g. Finite.exists_le bounds all n_g by one N. Multiplying by the remaining powers shows f^N a belongs to L_s. Since f has an invertible germ at the selected point of D(f), Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem gives the required reverse inclusion. The denominator-clearing argument is the fully proved private exists_pow_mul_mem_of_germ_mem. No infinite intersection is localized.

Identify L_s with the original intersection L. Membership in L implies membership of every restriction in K_f by functoriality of restriction. Conversely, for a in L_s and any original chart V_j, test its restriction at each stalk using IsAffineOpen.mem_ideal_iff. Choose a finite-cover basic open D(f) containing the point. Membership in K_f and compatibility give membership in the J_j stalk; germ_res identifies this with the germ of a restricted to V_j. Hence a belongs to the original intersection. At the given point y choose a covering D(f); the finite principal-open calculation gives the L_s stalk ideal, and germ_res and the original compatibility identify it with the J_i stalk ideal. All steps compile from Mathlib; both private helpers are sorry-free.

proof_origin.place: Finite principal-open and denominator-clearing argument, using Stacks Tag 01HR, Lemma 26.5.1(2) and the structure-sheaf localization calculation of Lemma 26.5.4; Tag 00E8. theorem affineCoverIdeal_map_germ
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (U : Y.affineOpens)
    {ι : Type v} (V : ι → Y.affineOpens) (hV : ∀ i, (V i).1 ≤ U.1)
    (J : ∀ i, Ideal Γ(Y, (V i).1))
    (hcover : ∀ y : Y, y ∈ U.1 → ∃ i, y ∈ (V i).1)
    (hcompat : ∀ i j (y : Y) (hi : y ∈ (V i).1) (hj : y ∈ (V j).1),
      (J i).map (Y.presheaf.germ (V i).1 y hi).hom =
        (J j).map (Y.presheaf.germ (V j).1 y hj).hom)
    (i : ι) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ (V i).1) :
    (⨅ j, (J j).comap (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hV j)).op).hom).map
        (Y.presheaf.germ U.1 y (hV i hy)).hom =
      (J i).map (Y.presheaf.germ (V i).1 y hy).hom
